name: Rumbletect
title: Rumbletect · Design the rumble
description: Rumbletect designs the continuous sound of jets, airliners, rockets, and volcanic eruptions from their physics: plan their paths in 3D, place microphones, and hear what arrives.
socialDescription: Design the continuous sound of jets, airliners, rockets, and eruptions from their physics. Plan a flight or an ascent in 3D over real terrain, place microphones, and listen in stereo, binaurally, or export Ambisonics.
